'''2007 Ohio State Championship Michael Pistone LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' CRIKEY, THAT STINGRAY'S TAIL IS HUGE!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
